restaurantName: Fried Banana Rama 5 (Bang Kruai - Sai Noi Road)
address: 116 Bang Kruai - Sai Noi Road, Bang Si Thong, Bang Kruai, Nonthaburi, 11130, Thailand
bio: This spot is best known for its deep-fried bananas. Coated in crispy batter made from coconut and white sesame, they exude a rich coconut aroma. The sweet potato balls are another standout. Be prepared for queues during peak hours....
